conclusion: Preliminary single-seed result (seed 7, mse only): OLS shows lower test MSE than the matched training-mean predictor under 10% test-label outliers of magnitude 10 with clean training data. This is a preliminary report from one seed and one metric; no broader claim is made.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric result cannot support generalization.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
